claims.quote: Hemiancistrus subviridis is a suckermouth catfish from the upper Orinoco and Casiquiare drainages in southern Venezuela, where it lives in cracks between granite rocks in flowing water.
Upper Orinoco and Casiquiare drainages in Amazonas state, Venezuela.
The Catalog of Fishes also lists it from Colombia, where the Orinoco forms the border.
